title: Tides: the big picture
outro_say: That's Tides. | It describes conditions. It never says buy or sell.

steps.say: Tides is the big picture: the money flows behind every chart. | Rates, the dollar, fear, credit, and where money is rotating.
Open Tides on the dashboard. | At the top, the Tide: coming in, slack, or going out. | And the sea state: how rough the markets are.

steps.screen: The winds for crypto and equities
steps.say: The winds apply it to each market. | A tailwind helps longs there. A headwind works against them.
Under it, the Navigator's daily note: today's readings in plain words, facts only.
Storm warnings flag the big scheduled releases: the Fed, inflation, and jobs.
The waves draw each current over time, with past event days marked.
And each current, scored against its own last five years, with which way it's pulling.
Today's AI Passage Plan applies all of this to your own assets and funnels. | One plan a day, kept in your logbook.
And you can add your own take: agree, disagree, and a short comment.
